facts.quote: Artificial Analysis publishes the average cost per task of running its Intelligence Index, which makes the same point with independent data. From its leaderboard, captured November 10, 2026:
facts.note: copy of the Artificial Analysis leaderboard captured 10 Nov 2026 (Intelligence Index v5.x): the AA source of the k7-boards lot (id to be linked at integration; the repo holds src-artificialanalysis-leaderboards-models-2026-11-09 without Fable 5.2). The medium level (56, $3.80) is absent from Kingy (which has low/high/xhigh/max in LangAlpha) and conflicts with the LangAlpha task_costs.json "medium not measured" for AA (our src-github-ginlix-ai-langalpha-task-costs-2026-11-09)

facts.where: section The Cost-per-Task Catch
facts.quote: The clearest evidence is in Anthropic's system card . On FrontierCode 2.0, Fable 5.2's average cost per task climbs from $2.10 at low effort to $44.70 at max, and the score peaks one step earlier, at xhigh.
facts.note: copy of the Anthropic system card section 8.4 (FrontierCode 2.0, Cognition): our src-anthropic-fable-5-2-system-card-2026-11-09 (k7-anthropic); same numbers as Kingy (our src-kingy.ai-fable-5-2-benchmarks-2026-11-09)
